## What's Changed
* Add PR CI checks and fix escaped dollar markdown round-trip by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/203
* Upgrade Quick Note with TipTap editor, add overlay/shortcut utilities by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/204
* Extract table inline controls context menus delete support (#205) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/205
* Enhance Help menu with links, commands, and unified event handling by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/206
* Wikilink improvements and hardening: dot-in-filename support, extension detection refactor by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/207
* Improve file tree drag-and-drop into expanded folders by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/224
* [codex] unify editor suggestion engine by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/228
* fix: inline HTML attributes and hex color values no longer parsed as tags by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/234
* Add details and toggle blocks to the TipTap editor by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/235
* Polish the in-app create folder flow by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/236
* Add "Copy File Path" to file context menus and command palette by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/242
* Preserve rich editor caret across resets by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/243
* Save pasted images using original name (#244) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/244
* Collections filtering, grouping, and board UX improvements by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/246
* Fix Git Sync default for adopted repositories by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/248
* Add separate editor font setting by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/250
* Add Activity Timeline as default All Notes view by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/251
* Fix editor crash when view is unavailable during selection snapshot by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/253


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5
